_note: Text for the first-visit tours, in ASD-STE100. Build mode (issue #123): the steps follow TOUR_STEPS in lib/game/tour.ts. The lobby, for a new user after the first log-in: the steps follow LOBBY_TOUR_STEPS.
label: Tour of build mode

tasks.title: The task list
tasks.text: This list shows each task of the level. A tick means that the task is done. The ring shows the task that you do now.

connections.title: The connection list
connections.text: After a failed Check, this list shows each connection. A green tick means that the connection is right. A red cross means that it is wrong.

clear.title: Clear
clear.text: Clear removes the parts that you put in this level. To put them back, press Undo.

check.title: Check
check.text: When all tasks are done, press Check. Check tests your board. Check stays off until then.

build.title: Build it for me
build.text: This button shows the build, one step at a time. It clears your parts first. It does not give XP.

start.title: Welcome to Jumper
start.text: Jumper teaches you hardware. You connect real parts on a 3D breadboard, one level at a time. Start here: this card opens the level that you play now.

nav.title: Your projects and builds
nav.text: Projects shows each project that you can play. My builds shows the boards that you save in build mode.

xp.title: Your XP
xp.text: You get XP when you pass a level. This number shows all your XP.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.text: Open your profile to change your name, your character and your password. You can show this tour again from there.

play.title: Build
play.text: This button opens the level that you play now. In build mode, a short tour shows each control.

dashboard.title: Your dashboard
dashboard.text: The dashboard shows your progress, your mistakes and the words that you learn.
